key_idea: Find the shape of the white gap, then find pieces that cover it with nothing left over.
steps: There are 5 white squares: 1 in the top row, 2 in the middle row and 2 in the bottom row.
The 2 white squares in the bottom row sit side by side. The green 2-square piece fits there.
The other 3 white squares make a small L: the top square, the one under it, and the one to the left of that.
Turn the orange L piece and it fills those 3 squares.

choice_feedback.A: The straight 3-square piece can only go down the second column. Then the 2 white squares left over do not touch, so the green piece cannot fit.
choice_feedback.C: This U-shaped piece does not match the shape of the white gap.
choice_feedback.D: This big L needs 3 squares in a line going down and 3 going across, but the gap has only one line of 3.
choice_feedback.E: This step-shaped piece does not match the shape of the white gap.
